name: @tiptap/codemod-v3-to-v4
description: Migrate Tiptap Vue package imports for v4

scripts.test: pnpm test:javascript && pnpm test:typescript && pnpm test:tsx && pnpm test:json && pnpm test:vue
scripts.test:javascript: codemod jssg test -l javascript scripts/vue-package-renames.ts tests/javascript
scripts.test:json: codemod jssg test -l json scripts/vue-package-renames.ts tests/json
scripts.test:tsx: codemod jssg test -l tsx scripts/vue-package-renames.ts tests/tsx
scripts.test:typescript: codemod jssg test -l typescript scripts/vue-package-renames.ts tests/typescript
